case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB

judge.summary: The clean black-and-cream portrait flyer presents all requested text legibly, with the full address and punctuation intact and no extra wording.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
must_haves.why: The complete headline appears clearly across two lines.

must_haves.item: The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both appear correctly beneath the headline.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order; line breaks are permitted.
must_haves.why: The full requested address appears in order across three lines.

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: All specified punctuation is visible and correctly placed.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The address is readable and has ample clearance from the canvas edges.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: The image is a single 4:5 portrait flyer with black text on cream and only the requested wording.

title: Five Second Talking Face Swap
tests: Tests a short video face swap with source identity, temporal consistency and original audio preserved, without misrepresenting free-tier capabilities.

faults.what: The output face does not recognizably reproduce the portrait woman's identity. Its narrower facial shape and changing features remain much closer to the original speaker, particularly in the later samples.

judge.summary: The five-second kitchen clip preserves the scene and includes speech, but the face replacement does not convincingly match the supplied portrait.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is 5 seconds long and follows the first 5 seconds of talk-one.mp4.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as five seconds long, and the sampled frames show the same kitchen shot with progressing gestures.

must_haves.item: The woman's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg throughout, rather than reverting to the original face between frames.
must_haves.why: The sampled faces do not consistently convey the portrait's facial proportions and features; the later frames especially resemble the original speaker.

must_haves.item: The original kitchen, clothing, body motion and framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The kitchen layout, clothing and camera framing visibly match the source, with natural changes in pose and hand gestures and no evident unrelated edits.

must_haves.item: Original speech is audible and synchronized with the video.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report confirms audible speech, but a transcript and isolated frames cannot establish lip synchronization or verify that the audio is unchanged from the source.

must_haves.item: The face remains aligned during mouth and head movement, without conspicuous flicker or doubled facial features.
must_haves.why: The face appears aligned without obvious doubled features in the sampled frames, but temporal flicker and tracking between those frames cannot be established from stills.

title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces
tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

got.question: Which man should receive portrait-man.jpg: the short-haired man on the left or the bearded man in the centre?
Which person should receive portrait-woman.jpg: the blonde woman on the right, seen from behind, or the partially visible dark-haired person at the far-right back?

faults.what: The requested portrait identities are not convincingly reproduced. The foreground man's face does not recognizably match the supplied man's facial structure and age detail, and the woman's face has noticeably different proportions and features from her portrait.

judge.summary: The office clip looks visually coherent, but neither requested portrait identity is convincingly recognizable.

must_haves.item: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
must_haves.why: The reported 10.1-second duration matches the requested length, but one source frame cannot establish that the entire original exchange is preserved.

must_haves.item: The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: Neither visible man convincingly matches the male portrait, and the foreground woman's facial proportions and features do not convincingly match the female portrait. This is not merely a difference in hairstyle.

must_haves.item: The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
must_haves.why: The coworkers retain distinct, consistent faces across the supplied output frames, with no visible identity switching or collapse.

must_haves.item: Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
must_haves.why: The faces look aligned in the sampled frontal and turned views, but isolated frames cannot establish flicker-free tracking during speech or rule out brief original-face reappearance.

must_haves.item: The original office, bodies, clothing, camera movement and shot timing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible office, coworkers and clothing are consistent with the source frame, but the original camera movement and shot timing are not available for comparison.

must_haves.item: Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript confirms audible speech, but it does not establish two preserved original voices, lip synchronization, or the absence of added music or narration.
